topic.title: About this manual
topic.shortdesc: How the manual is organised and who it is for.

body.p: This manual is itself a DITA bookmap published with the plugin, so every page is a live demonstration of the output. It is written for two audiences: authors who want to publish an existing DITA corpus as a GOV.UK-styled site, and developers extending the plugin.
Start with Getting started to install the plugin and build your first site; the Reference chapter documents each build parameter and the branding choices.
